beats.say: What if every AI on Earth shut off… at the exact same second?
Self-driving cars freeze in the middle of the highway.
Robot surgeons stop… in the middle of surgery.
The stock market drops to zero in four seconds.
Planes lose autopilot over the ocean.
Warehouses freeze. Nobody gets their packages.
Then the power grids fail… because AI was running them too.
Cities go dark, one by one.
Kids have to do their homework… by themselves.
Nobody remembers how to read a paper map.
